eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Lassen, CA; at 6:56 PM on AUG 16, 2021 Effective until 6:56 PM AUG 17, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
A NEW MANDATORY EVACUATION ORDER HAS BEEN ISSUED FOR Janesville area west of Hwy 395 from the Bass Hill area south to Janesville Grade including the Janesville side of Wingfield Rd and west to the County Line

ALL PREVIOUSLY ISSUED ORDERS AND WARNINGS REMAIN IN PLACE

Call dispatch for assistance evacuating 530-257-6121. An Emergency Shelter is located at Lassen Community College in Susanville.  The Shelter number is (530) 250-9004.  Large animals can be taken to Lassen County Fairgrounds.
